name: Dropbox Plus
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Dropbox Plus, back up selected folders to a user-owned encrypted object store with version history. The hard boundary is global sync, conflict handling, sharing, mobile apps, recovery, and infrastructure durability, plus reliability, durability, and cross-device sync.
